definitions.gloss: delayed arrival; arriving later than scheduled
definitions.explanation: Arrival later than the scheduled time, typically of a train, bus, plane, or delivery. {延着|えんちゃく}する means to arrive late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{延着|えんちゃく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{延着|えんちゃく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The plane arrived late because of heavy snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧{延着|えんちゃく}し、⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{待|ま}たされた。
examples.english: Due to an accident, the express train arrived an hour late, and passengers were kept waiting at the station.

notes:
Arrival later than the scheduled time — used for trains, planes, buses, and deliveries. The opposite event, departing late, is ⟦{延発|えんぱつ}→延発：29094_enpatsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{延着|えんちゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the train arrives late
- ⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{延着|えんちゃく}: a one-hour delay in arrival

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遅延|ちえん}→遅延：06749_chien⟧: delay — the general word for a transport delay, more common in station announcements
- {延着|えんちゃく}: focuses specifically on the late arrival itself
